Allow Stad to see which app is open

Stad uses Android's Accessibility service to block the apps you choose.

What it accesses: which app and screen are open (the app's package name and the screen's name), each time you switch screens.

Why: so it can cover a blocked app with Stad's block screen while you're locked.

It never reads what's on the screen or what you type. These names are not stored, shared or sent anywhere.

Stad needs this to block apps. Without it, nothing is blocked.

If you turn it off while Stad is locked, Stad notes when, so you can see it later on this phone.

If you agree, Android's Accessibility settings will open. Turn on "Stad app blocker" there.
